notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant and Piggie book. The main characters Gerald (elephant) and Piggie (pig) are highly distinctive and will not be represented accurately by generic Boardmaker symbols — custom clip art strongly recommended. The core humour involves Gerald telling an increasingly absurd story about how he broke his trunk by carrying hippos, a rhino, and Piggie on it. Key vocabulary reflects the storytelling/narrative structure of the book (story, funny, ouch, try) as well as the central characters and event. 'Ouch' captures the injury/pain concept central to the plot. 'Try' reflects the recurring Elephant and Piggie theme of perseverance.
